notes.title: August small update!
Shadow Bonds hotfix 3
notes.notes:
Greetings, envoys!
Today's hotfix includes the following changes:
[list][*] Fixed the character creation screen getting stuck on subsequent playthroughs;
[*] Fixed some backgrounds going rogue and appearing randomly under others during transitions;
[*] Fixed the space bar not working correctly || [i]You can use the space bar to hide the UI and admire the artwork without the textbox![/i]
[*] Disabled the use of the mouse scroll wheel || [i]This will prevent players from accidentally scrolling through text. You can still skip using the Ctrl keys![/i]
[*] Added a line of text to the 'Controls' codex entry || [i]You can use Backspace to quickly access the 'More' menu;[/i]
[*] Added a line of text to the ending || [i]So much more awaits players in the full game, and now it should be clearer[/i] ːsweetelfː
[*] Made codex entry 10 slightly easier to obtain;[/list]
Thank you all for playing and reporting these issues!
We hope you're enjoying your time in Carolise ːcharmwitchː

notes.title: Shadow Bonds hotfix 2
notes.notes:

notes.title: Shadow Bonds hotfix 1
Shadow Bonds pre-release patch
notes.notes:
Greetings, envoys!

We just pushed a pre-release patch for [i]Shadow Bonds[/i].

Here's what changed:
[list][*] Lowered default volume at startup || [i]If you already started the game, your own settings will be given priority.[/i]
[*] Added humor indicators to the first humor choice
[*] Added a bit of tutorial text when unlocking the first codex entry || [i]This should offer more guidance to players![/i]
[*] Fixed some stray typos
[*] Bardier music plays at the Rose during specific scenes
[*] Minor change to Marané's CG
[*] Fixed a small issue in Ornell's evening event
[*] Added UI sounds to the content warning screen and the credits screen
[/list]
We also made some under-the-hood changes to the way the character creation screen works.
This will unfortunately [b]break existing saves in the first scene[/b] (everything that happens before going to the Refrain).

Thank you all for testing the game!

[b]EDIT[/b]: today's hotfix (April 5) fixes some duplicate wording in the [spoiler]swindler event[/spoiler]. Now the [i]mind control[/i] option has stronger wording than the simple question.
